card.statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be any set of relations and $T(L)$ any Gelfand-Tsetlin tableau.

- [(i)] We will say that $T(L)$ satisfies $\mathcal{C}$ if:

- [$\bullet$] $l_{ij}-l_{rs}\in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ for any $((i,j); (r,s))\in \mathcal{C}^+\cup\mathcal{C}^0$.

- [$\bullet$] $l_{ij}-l_{rs}\in \mathbb{Z}_{> 0}$ for any $((i,j); (r,s))\in \mathcal{C}^-$.

- [(ii)] We say that $T(L)$ is a $\mathcal{C}$-realization if $T(L)$ satisfies $\mathcal{C}$ and for any $1\leq k\leq n-1$ we have, $l_{ki}-l_{kj}\in \mathbb{Z} $ if and only if $(k,i)$ and $(k,j)$ in the same connected component of $G(\mathcal{C})$.

- [(iii)] Suppose that $T(L)$ satisfies $\mathcal{C}$. By ${\mathcal B}_{\mathcal{C}}(T(L))$ we denote the set of all tableaux of the form $T(L+z)$, $z\in {\mathbb Z}_0^{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}}$ satisfying $\mathcal{C}$. By $V_{\mathcal{C}}(T(L))$ we denote the complex vector space spanned by ${\mathcal B}_{\mathcal{C}}(T(L))$.
card.label: Definition 8

paper.title: Combinatorial construction of Gelfand-Tsetlin modules for $\mathfrak{gl}_n$
paper.abstract: We propose a new effective method of constructing explicitly Gelfand -Tsetlin modules for $\mathfrak{gl}_n$. We obtain a large family of simple modules that have a basis consisting of Gelfand-Tsetlin tableaux, the action of the Lie algebra is given by the Gelfand-Tsetlin formulas and with all Gelfand-Tsetlin multiplicities equal $1$. As an application of our construction we prove necessary and sufficient condition for the Gelfand and Graev's continuation construction to define a module which was conjectured by Lemire and Patera.
